description: This file contains the implementation of a PowerPoint presentation generator using the PptxGenJS library. It defines functions for processing template data, rendering slides with placeholders, images, and shapes, and producing a PPTX Blob along with a filename. It handles slide layout configurations, dynamic content injection, image conversion, and applies specific formatting rules for different slide types, notably 'global first' and 'global last'.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string looks like a data URL based on its prefix.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File or string resource into a data URL, supporting reading from local files and fetch responses.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob into a data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations to input values, such as formatting percentages, currency, or converting bullets to lines.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the deck title based on wizard data, prioritizing the globalFirst name or defaulting to 'presentation'.

methods.name: formatGlobalFirstLabeledLine(fieldId, rawValue)
methods.description: Formats 'name' and 'date' fields for Global First slides, adding labels and handling empty values.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to create a safe filename with lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field value from wizard data depending on the scope and group/slide identifiers.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches for layout measurements.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder text as fallback content in a slide if actual data is missing.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds a fallback image to a slide if image data from URL or file is available.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders static shapes (like rectangles and images) based on the layout's fixedShapes configuration.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main function that creates a PowerPoint file from a template, slide sequence, and wizard data. It manages layout, placeholders, images, text rendering, and produces a downloadable Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
